chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, who said:
Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام used to say: the khutbah, the Jumuʿah, and the two-rakʿah salat are not to be held with fewer than five persons: the Imam and four others.

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the prayer leader who leads the Jumuʿah
key_terms.الْخُطْبَةُ: the sermon delivered as part of the Friday prayer service
key_terms.خَمْسَةِ رَهْطٍ: a group of five persons, the minimum number mentioned here
key_terms.صَلَاةُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ: the two-rakʿah salat performed for Jumuʿah

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number required to establish Jumuʿah prayer according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the minimum number required for Jumuʿah. It indicates that the khutbah and the two-rakʿah Friday salat are not established with fewer than five people, consisting of the Imam and four others.
